thread:
elaine: Quickcheck — we're running the post + webinar + benchmark narrative launch next week. Need a compact SEO playbook for: keywords, JSON-LD, internal linking anchors, and a redirect sweep. Who can own the routing + redirects?
sam: I can own redirects and the sitemap update. Will do a preflight CSV and ping infra for fast applying.
matt: I'll own schema + canonical tags. Will push a tiny JSON-LD snippet for webinar pages.
olga: I'll do the keyword set and anchor guidance for internal links. Short list only — we can't spam anchors.
elaine: Thanks — timeline: publish posts Tue 09:00 ET, webinar Wed 11:00 ET, benchmark narrative live Wed 14:00 ET. Redirects must be in prod by Tue 08:00 ET so no 404s.
jess: Heads up, deploy-bot will only allow changes during the 07:00-09:00 window. We need the CSV earlier.
sam: Copy of CSV schema I'll use:
```
source_path,target_path,redirect_type,reason,owner
/old-post,/new-post,301,consolidate-launch,sam
/blog/preview,/blog/webinar,302,temp-banner,marketing
```
matt: JSON-LD example for webinar hub — please copy and edit headline & date: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Launch & Benchmarks","startDate":"2026-04-08T11:00:00-04:00","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/launch-benchmarks"}
```
olga: Keyword clustering (short):
- launch LLM inference platform
- inference latency benchmarking
- webinar + benchmark narrative
Anchor guidance: use natural anchors, prefer "inference benchmarking" or "launch webinar". Avoid exact-match spam for org-level pages.
elaine: Good. For internal linking matrix — quick matrix in a shared Google Sheet. Column headers: page, suggested_anchor, target, priority. Keep priority 1 for webinar hub + benchmark narrative.
jess: Also confirm canonical strategy: canonical -> canonicalized URL on production domain (no UTM). Matt, add canonical meta to the JSON-LD PR?
matt: Canonical meta handled in template; I'll add rel=canonical to the webinar and narrative templates. Also adding meta robots for preview pages: `noindex,follow`.
sam: Redirect sweep plan: 1) generate CSV from sheet, 2) review + signoff from SEO, 3) infra apply via patch job, 4) smoke test. I'll attach smoke test steps in the sheet.
elaine: Who's doing anchor-level QA? We need a quick pass on 15 high-value pages.
olga: I'll do the anchor QA for the top 15. Will post results by Mon EOD.
seo-bot: Reminder: broken-link-monitor will run Tue 09:30 ET and post failures to #support.
jess: Minor FYI — for Nginx redirects use the canonical ordering (exact matches first). Example in config: `rewrite ^/old-post$ /new-post permanent;`
matt: Also: schema for benchmark narrative should include sameAs links + author object. I'll draft in the doc and tag you all.
sam: Post-publish checks: sitemap updated, robots.txt unchanged, redirect rules live, noindex previews. I will mark checklist items in the sheet.
elaine: OK team — owners recap: sam=redirects+sitemap, matt=schema+canonical, olga=keywords+anchor QA, jess=deploy coordination, elaine=final signoff + messaging sync.
olga: Quick ask — for internal anchors, can we reserve the phrase "inference economics" for the benchmark narrative? Want consistent anchor text.
elaine: Yes, reserve it. Add to sheet as 'reserved_anchor' column.
seo-bot: Scheduled reminder set for Mon 16:00 ET to review anchor QA.
jess: All right — send the sheet link when ready and I'll file the infra ticket. :thumbsup:
